name: Fairmont Jakarta
positioning: Fairmont city hotel at Gelora Bung Karno Senayan in Jakarta, with a direct tunnel to Plaza Senayan
best_for: Travelers who want a Senayan base with direct access to Plaza Senayan and Sentral Senayan Office Towers
Guests who want halal-certified Indonesian dining on site
Families looking for weekend activities and a welcome gift for children

facts.text: Fairmont Jakarta is located at Jl. Asia Afrika No. 8, Gelora Bung Karno Senayan.
A direct access tunnel connects the hotel to Plaza Senayan and Sentral Senayan Office Towers.
The Fairmont Spa is on the 4th floor and has a steam room, a sauna and an indoor jacuzzi.
The hotel has a halal-certified restaurant, 1945 Indonesian Restaurant, on the 3rd floor.
BAR ON G serves cocktails that celebrate Indonesian flavors, made by Head Mixologist Ale Maraben.
Spectrum Restaurant serves a Sunday brunch.
Fairmont Gold rooms are on high floors and include access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge, a deluxe breakfast and a host bar with canapes.
Fairmont King rooms have a Japanese spa-inspired bathroom with a rainforest shower and Le Labo amenities.
Young guests receive a welcome goodie bag of coloring activities and house-made cookies on arrival.
Certified instructors teach yoga in personal or group classes at a private studio room.
Parking is included, in an indoor parking facility.

highlights.text: BAR ON G serves cocktails that celebrate Indonesian flavors, made by Head Mixologist Ale Maraben.
The hotel has a halal-certified restaurant, 1945 Indonesian Restaurant, on the 3rd floor.
Sky Suites have an exclusive check-in and lift, a fully equipped kitchen, and separate living and dining areas.
A direct access tunnel connects the hotel to Plaza Senayan and Sentral Senayan Office Towers.
Family-friendly weekend activities are held at the Herbs Garden.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that Jakarta traffic congestion can affect travel times to and from the hotel, especially at peak hours.
WhataHotel notes this is a city hotel, so guests wanting a beach or resort setting would need to travel beyond Jakarta.
The Fairmont Gold Lounge, deluxe breakfast and host bar come with Fairmont Gold rooms, not every room type.
